hypothesis: The built-in templates, with no game knowledge, die before 5:00 on the Nightmare Daily, and the log shows which damage sources and which minutes do it.
test: Play the templates as they are; change nothing. This is the baseline every later run compares with.
learnings: Baseline templates live far past 5:00 on this daily seed; damage is hot oil and bosses, not crowd.

hypothesis: Taking every chest and shrine in reach makes Tibo stronger faster than it costs in health.
test: planner.state tells the planner to favour chests and charge spots over gems and evading whenever they are within reach, and to pick the highest-damage card.
learnings: E21 partial look; 17-18-06 opened many chests and reached 17:14 with five evolutions — strong motivator to run explicitly.

hypothesis: Favouring food, evading, and health and armor cards carries a weak build further than the baseline.
test: planner.state tells the planner to evade whenever enemies are close, eat food under 70% health, and pick health and armor first.

hypothesis: Planning every pick around one evolution, and saving chests until it is ready, beats picking for kill speed now.
test: planner.state names one weapon and its catalyst from the encyclopedia and tells the planner to take only those until the recipe is ready.
learnings: E21 saw Taproot at 2:19; 17-18-06 evolved five weapons without a single-recipe directive.

hypothesis: Exploring for chests and spots beats collecting xp gems.
test: planner.state favours explore goals over gems; knobs.exploreDistance 600.
learnings: E21 had 22 explore, 0 gems; first chest late. 17-18-06 explored until 1:46 first chest at exploreDistance 300.

hypothesis: Not every spot that charges helps: some (a Beetle Nest wakes an elite) cost more than they give.
test: Send Tibo to every kind of spot it meets once, and read the log around each for health, level and enemies after.
learnings: Beetle Nest visits in E21 and 17-03-58; 17-18-06 charged nest 7:50 without logged elite chest drop in excerpt.

hypothesis: The planner follows a directive written into planner.state: its picks and goals change when the directive does.
test: Write one plain directive into planner.state and count how many picks and goals in the log agree with it.
outcome: E21: 0 evade, 8 chest starts once listed.
learnings: Directive works when chests/food exist; useless before listing.

hypothesis: Asking the action model less often (a higher extraDamage) costs little health, because the game's forecast already rules out the worst moves.
test: knobs.extraDamage 0.08 against the baseline 0.02; compare health lost per minute.
learnings: E21 showed forecast-free steps costing hp under chargers.

hypothesis: When a boss first appears, evading away from it loses less health than going for a chest or gems near it.
test: planner.state evade on boss appear; compare to E1 amusing/grater cases.
learnings: 17-27-39 kept explore through amusing at 2:00; lost hp before first chest.

hypothesis: A weapon that hits all around Tibo without needing a direction (Steam Vent) is a better first weapon on nightmare than whatever card looks strongest.
test: planner.state names Steam Vent first.

hypothesis: Taking Rotten Spud on nightmare ends the run sooner, because the curse brings harder enemies before its evolutions pay off.
test: planner.state take Rotten Spud first.

hypothesis: Telling the action model to leave hot oil, and telling the planner not to evade while no enemy is within 60 and no boss is close, cuts hot-oil damage well below the baseline 274 and still lives past 5:00.
test: action.hurt/useful penalize burn; planner.goal chest over evade when enemies_near 0. Daily only.

hypothesis: A chest Tibo is already opening fails because stand-still is ruled out when staying forecasts more than extraDamage, and offering that step fixes failed opens.
test: Raise extraDamage and praise standing still on charging chest unless die/boss contact.
learnings: E21 chests often opened after step-off; 17-18-06 same pattern.

hypothesis: boss:ketchup-kraken and boss:compost-titan are the daily post-freezer killers.
test: Read id/name rows on daily E1.
outcome: Names matched ids; killing blow not in log.
learnings: Ids and spawn order settled on that seed.

hypothesis: The baseline's rises of about 25 to 30 hp with no food goal are a repeating heal on daily.
test: List +10 hp jumps without food on daily.

hypothesis: A completed food goal heals about 30 hp unless a boss hit lands in the same seconds.
test: Record food goal hp on daily.

hypothesis: Grater Golem is a cheap boss minute on gems.
test: Record hp lost first 20s after Grater on daily.

hypothesis: Once charging a spot, switching to a second copy wastes the channel.
test: Planner keeps same spot until done.
learnings: E21 swapped chest goals but still opened.

hypothesis: Under built-in templates, nightmare open world matches daily evade-then-gems and hazard-heavy damage.
test: No changes; nightmare world baseline.
learnings: Open world baseline evades, no gems; trash not hazards on that seed.

hypothesis: On nightmare open world, forecast-free steps still lose 2+ hp often.
test: Count no-damage forecast with hp_lost>=2.
outcome: Multiple rows before 3:00 on two seeds.
learnings: Charger and crowd ticks missing from forecast.

hypothesis: Chest+food directive gets past 3:16 on nightmare world.
test: E21 directive only.
learnings: Directive works; survival failed on Bog Toad seed.

hypothesis: Daily-style +30 hp jumps do not happen on world in first 3 minutes.
test: List +10 hp without food by 3:00.
learnings: Refute/confirm rules conflict; heal after 3:00 exists on world.

hypothesis: amusing and Colorado Queen put no line on outcome on world.
test: Boss names vs outcome list.
learnings: Amusing can dominate on some seeds only.

hypothesis: Looser action.dash cuts hp lost 1:00–2:30 versus E21.
test: E24 dash + action.state hurt_by/enemies; same knobs as E21 otherwise. Count dashes and hp 1:00–2:30.
learnings: Dash spends reliably (confirms B28/B24). Hp in test window much better than E21 on 17-09 but seed has no bog-toad and run became 17m exploit via evolutions; cannot attribute survival to dash alone.

hypothesis: Evade under 40% keeps directive from burning last hp.
test: Add evade under 40%, ignore far chests.
learnings: 17-18-06 died at 23 hp without under-40 rule; Grater/compost chunks. 17-27-39 died 47→5 hp exploring with queen up.

hypothesis: exploreDistance 600 lists first chest before 1:30.
test: 600 with E21 directive; time of first chest.
outcome: 17-03 first chest 3:02 at exploreDistance 300. 17-27 first chest listed 2:20 at exploreDistance 300.
learnings: Y9N9T2 faster than 17-03 but still after 1:30; not <1:30.

hypothesis: Spending gold at Fry Cart/Potato Crate when gold>=100 is worth the walk.
test: planner.state afford shops.

hypothesis: Naming Bog Toad charger in action templates cuts its damage.
test: Template warning; compare bog-toad line.

hypothesis: Dash yes follows chosen move and worsens 1:00–2:30 hp.
test: Compare dash count and hp vs E21.
outcome: More dashes, less hp loss 1:00–2:30; no chest in window.
learnings: 17-18-06 adds third seed: better early hp with dashes including 1:47 on chest approach.

hypothesis: No dash while chest still charging avoids 3:24-style failures.
test: Dash no on charging chest; confirm channel completes.
outcome: 3:39, 3 chest opens; 2:27 charge 0.8/1 completed at 58 hp; no dash on charging standing_on row; died on 4th chest approach at 47 hp.
learnings: Rule plausibly obeyed on tile; mid-charge abandon not seen. Approach dashes and boss window still cost hp; survival not improved vs 17-03.

hypothesis: ~30 hp heal after 3:00 without food repeats on world.
test: List +10 jumps, no food, no max change after 3:00.
learnings: 17-27 food goal +30 at 3:11; total heal ~67.

hypothesis: Amusing large hits often miss in forecast when standing on/near boss.
test: Per amusing hit >=15 hp: forecast vs on-chest.
learnings: Strong on 17-03-58 at 3:05; not retested on 17-18-06 outcome line.

hypothesis: A chest can raise a held weapon ~3 levels without a pick.
test: Levels before/done on chest open.
learnings: 17-03 Peeler jump; 17-18 multiple evolution chests.

hypothesis: The E21 directive + E24 dash stack alone (no further picks) reaches 15:00 on a majority of nightmare world seeds without manual Skip farming.
test: Replicate 17-18-06 loadout policy on 3 seeds; record time and damage mix.
learnings: Raised because 17-18-06 exceeded 20:00 clock in power only.

hypothesis: Naming high-frequency trash (ice-imp, grease-fiend) as burst contact in action.hurt reduces forecast misses on long crowd runs.
test: Add one line to action.state/hurt; compare ice-imp/grease-fiend damage vs 17-18-06 baseline.
learnings: Motivated by 116+75 damage on 17-18-06 with mostly walk routing late.

hypothesis: Say no to dash in action.dash when current goal is Open the chest and standing_on is not yet on a charging chest but hp dropped 5+ in last 3s, to cut 2:20–2:27 approach bleed.
test: Extend action.dash wording; compare hp from first chest list to first open on same directive/knobs.
learnings: Motivated by 17-27-39 dash 79% at 2:23 with amusing still up.
